title: Delayed diffusion with measure-valued kernels in nonlinear parabolic equations
summary: We study nonlinear parabolic equations with delayed diffusion terms governed by finite signed measure kernels. The atom of the kernel at the origin is absorbed into the present-time operator, while the remaining part is treated as a residual delay kernel. Under structural assumptions on the effective present-time operators and a pathwise coercivity condition for the total memory operator, we prove the existence and uniqueness of weak solutions and their stability under weak-star convergence of the kernels.
